comparison_design.limits: No saved pre-policy branch, common-shock guarantee or causal identification claim. W10 remains design work.
comparison_design.observation_timing: Settings at initialization, policy application and changed step boundaries; not an intra-tick trace.
comparison_design.pairing: same seed across independently initialized policy arms
comparison_design.policy_timing: before first step, after factory initialization

target_inflation_rate.description: Stored legacy target only; no engine response. Changing it does not set realized inflation.

gdp_this_tick.definition: Sum of Economy.last_tick_revenue; nominal sales proxy, not real GDP or a complete national account.

gini_coefficient.definition: Gini of household cash_balance only; excludes deposits, debt and ownership.

government_cash.definition: Treasury cash_balance; negative cash is not an issued debt instrument.

households_below_poverty.definition: Cash below government's current min_cash_threshold; threshold can change with benefits, not an independent poverty standard.

mean_happiness.definition: Mean household happiness, in model units; not empirically calibrated welfare.

mean_health.definition: Mean household health, in model units.

mean_price.definition: Unweighted mean of active firm prices; not a fixed consumption basket or CPI.

realized_inflation.definition: Requires an explicitly named price series and lag. The stored target is not this measure; these runners do not export CPI inflation.

unemployment_rate.definition: Economy metric: jobless/all households when count_cannot_work_as_unemployed is true; otherwise jobless who can_work/all who can_work. See runner-specific overrides.

runner_schema.consumer_distress: Alias of mean_distress; model composite defined in distress.py, not an empirical welfare estimate.
